title: Giant Amplifiers and Talk-Show Platforms on X
question: Which mega-accounts and daily shows take claims originating in groups 01-05 and give them 1M+ view distribution - and which platforms are ideological vs opportunistic?
scope: X public posts; T0 last 30 days; amplification tests = 72h after seed posts >50K views; ideology-vs-opportunism scoring with exhibits.
publicInterestBasis: Mega-accounts convert niche claims into million-view distribution; mapping who amplifies whom distinguishes reach from origin in the information chain.
confidence: **Confidence: high on the zero-amplification audit; high on typology; medium on bridge-node finding.**

bottomLine.text: **Disconfirming evidence honored — and it is the headline.** Quote-audits of two >1M-view seed posts (Stew's Shmuley clip 1.25M; Fuentes' Zionists-Epstein 1.03M) found **zero priority-roster quoters** across 40 sampled quotes; all amplifiers were sub-7K accounts. The mega-layer did not distribute these specific seeds. Reach ≠ relay here.

**Typology split (with exhibits):** **Ideological:** Dave Smith (910K) — announced Dershowitz Iran-war debate (104K); Massie RT (2M); fights EYakoby/Hammer ("two ass whoopings", 288K) while defending Candace by name. Judge Nap show (556K) — staff-run guest-menu format (bio disclaimer verified), Ritter ×2, Maté episode, Mearsheimer, Freeman "Israel is Now an American Problem". **Opportunistic:** Matt Wallace (2.36M) — Dolly Parton death-content loop + Mount Sinai 340B campaign via @usanewshq pseudo-wire framing; **zero Israel/Iran in sample**. Dom Lucre (1.69M) — 🔥🚨LATEST culture-war bait; one El-Sayed/Jews item (42K). **Hybrid/news-factory:** Nawfal (3.87M) — Iran-dominant pinned ("Economic D-Day" tripwire w/ Joe Kent — a Sulaiman-orbit name), staff bylines (Writer: Jamie/Michael), occasional wire credits (Le Parisien/Daily Mail), both-sides mix observable same-day. **Candace (7.8M):** explicit Israel nearly absent; her conflict content is the **Kirk-martyrdom investigation economy** (TPUSA text-leak demands 1M views; "DataRepublican = Pentagon PR war" 990K) with oblique signals (Jewish-billionaire odds subtweet; Moscow-pinned 10M).

**Bridge node found:** Aaron Maté appears as a Judging Freedom guest *while* engaging the clashreport wire (case-05) — the corridor-to-amplifier pathway runs through him, not through Hinkle/Shields/Sulaiman.

limitations: Entity resolution (14 handles incl backups/lookalikes) → quote-audit of two >1M seed posts → six-platform style harvest. First-page quote sampling only; no retweeter pull; no video/media-id matching; Judge Nap staff account treated as institutional voice. Validator: OK.
unknowns: Pointers: 01 (Hinkle praise of Drop Site sits at this layer's edge), 02 (Candace/Parker Kirk economy shared), 03 (Nawfal feud w/ Sulaiman documented there), 05 (Maté bridge). Unknowns: thumbnail rhetoric catalog; media-file reuse matching (needs media-id tooling); Wallace/Lucre team-production confirmation; right-of-reply outstanding.
contradictions: Candace attacked from pro-Israel right: present indirectly (Yakoby/Hammer vs Smith; DataRepublican war frame) — three A/B posts captured in case-02 lane too.

Nawfal both-sides test: same-day pair exists (nun-acquittal Israel-critical item alongside Piker-condemnation and settlements-defense Gaetz RT) — consistent with accusation but two items cannot prove pattern.
Smith↔Fuentes/Hinkle: no T0 contact in sample.
Jones/Galloway: UK dual-institution noted; Jones not deeply harvested (volume gate unmet).
